description: Deterministic local regression scenarios for the Proposal Readiness Score Pack scorer.

scenarios.title: Ready package with complete evidence and draft sections
scenarios.business_risk: A healthy package should not create false reviewer bottlenecks.

requirement_matrix.requirement_text: Vendor must support SSO and encryption controls.
requirement_matrix.suggested_response: Use approved SSO and encryption evidence.

requirement_matrix.requirement_text: Vendor must document SOC 2-oriented audit controls.
requirement_matrix.suggested_response: Cite compliance evidence and audit trail controls.

requirement_matrix.requirement_text: Vendor must provide onboarding timeline and owners.
requirement_matrix.suggested_response: Use implementation guide timeline and owner model.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: The proposal is ready for final executive review with cited evidence.

sections.title: Security Response
sections.body: SSO and encryption controls are supported by approved security evidence.

sections.title: Compliance Response
sections.body: SOC 2-oriented controls are mapped to compliance evidence.

sections.title: Implementation Response
sections.body: Onboarding timeline and owner model are grounded in implementation evidence.

scenarios.title: Compliance blocker creates HITL queue and blocked pack status
scenarios.business_risk: Unsupported regulated claims must block submission until a human exception is approved.

requirement_matrix.requirement_text: Vendor must support SSO and encryption controls.
Vendor must provide FedRAMP High authorization.
requirement_matrix.suggested_response: Do not claim unsupported FedRAMP authorization.
missing_evidence: No FedRAMP High authorization evidence found.

review_findings.message: FedRAMP High evidence is missing for req_fedramp_high.
review_findings.recommendation: Route an exception to legal and security before submission.

action_plan.title: Legal: approve FedRAMP exception
action_plan.description: Decide whether the unsupported regulated claim blocks this bid.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.body: Submission is blocked until the compliance exception is resolved.

sections.title: Security Response
sections.body: SSO and encryption controls are supported.

remediation: Attach approved FedRAMP evidence or remove the claim.
Capture legal/security exception approval before executive review.

scenarios.title: Standard eval failure lowers readiness despite complete matrix evidence
scenarios.business_risk: A package with citations can still be unsafe if standard eval quality gates fail.

requirement_matrix.requirement_text: Vendor must support SSO and encryption controls.
Vendor must document DPA and subprocessor controls.

sections.title: Executive Summary

sections.title: Privacy Response

remediation: Inspect eval failures before final response export.
